title: unified optimizer problem definition (DSL v1)
description: Engine-agnostic description of a continuous optimisation problem: variables with box bounds, one objective expression, optional analytic gradients, inequality/equality constraints. Expressions may only contain arithmetic and whitelisted math calls over the declared variable names (see tools/optimizer/unified/expr.py). The document is domain neutral: nothing here knows what the objective means physically.

x0.description: optional starting point; defaults to the bound midpoint

gradient.description: analytic d objective / d variable, one expression per variable in declaration order; omit to use central finite differences

sense.description: comparison of expr against threshold: le -> expr <= threshold, ge -> expr >= threshold, eq -> expr == threshold (inequalities are normalised internally to g(x) >= 0)

jac.description: analytic gradient of the constraint expression, one per variable in declaration order

metadata.description: free-form notes plus, optionally, the published reference optimum used to score the solve
